engine: ElevenLabs sound effects v2 on fal: text, duration_seconds (0.5-22), loop; prompt_influence if the endpoint exposes it
conventions: Times are absolute seconds in the 242 s main cut (242-252 is the alt tail). A placement with every repeats the sound from at to to on that interval. lvl is the target in the final master: LUFS short-term for loops and beds, peak dBFS for one-shots. lead is how many seconds the sound starts before the picture event or cut it belongs to (a J-cut); trail is how long it runs on after the cut (an L-cut). room names a treatment in mix_plan.md 3. gen false means built in numpy from electricity or from other recordings, never generated.
budget: 59 generated assets, one take each; up to 31 retakes inside the cap of 90. Longest asset 22 s; about 390 s of generated audio per pass.

sfx.treatment: Band-limit 90 Hz-7.5 kHz. Start each placement at a different offset in the loop (a different stretch of the print).
